== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Rod of [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]] is a staff utilized by [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] that features gold swirls and a ruby-studded tip. While it can be used to block physical strikes in melee combat, it is not primarily designed for such encounters. The artifact functions by drawing upon the emotions of others—such as [[Zakareth]]'s citizens—to power its abilities, though using it carries a heavy cost that can eventually strip a user of all feeling. One of its specific capabilities is the power to redirect the innate abilities of a [[Traveler]] back toward them. The weapon is kept within the [[Crimson Vault]] and has been used by both [[Zakareth]] and [[Queen]] [[Cynara]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Originally retrieved from the [[Crimson Vault]] by [[Cynara]], the Rod of [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]] is a powerful [[Ragnarus artifact]]. [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] holds the object in his right fist to exert his [[Authority|authority]]. He utilizes the rod to force various [[Incarnations]] into submission, employing its unique ability to turn a [[Traveler]]'s own powers against them.}}
